answers.text: '5.8% past the swing high is not chasing; at its high.' Granted on extension: D 0.3% under 20-day high, H1 91% of range is a stock at its high. But my claim rests on the Trend Template gate (C3), not extension: ma50 53.09 under ma100 53.73 and rs_rank_pct 68.65 under the 70 floor. W LH/LL agrees the longer trend has not ordered. All eight or none; the refutation does not touch the failing criteria.

'The 50/100-day stack is not my instrument.' It is mine: criterion 4 of the Trend Template (C3) needs the 50-day above the longer averages, and ma50 53.09 sits under ma100 53.73; rs_rank_pct 68.65 fails criterion 8. W swing LH/LL, 0.8% above its swing high, is a stage not yet confirmed (C2). D strength does not cure an unordered stack.

'Stack and RS are not mine. Price cleared both pivots.' Clearing a pivot is entry timing; my method runs the Trend Template first (C3, R1). ma50 104.9 < ma100 107.84 < ma200 108.61 and rs_rank_pct 51.13 fail it, W swing LH/LL. A break inside an inverted stack is not stage 2 (C2), and group confirmation from ETR, itself a template fail, adds nothing.

'Inverted longer stack with price above it is base context.' On my method an inverted stack is the disqualifier, not context: the 200-day must lead from below with the 50 over it (C3 criteria 2, 4). ma50 104.9 under ma200 108.61, rs_rank_pct 51.13 under the floor. D 3.4% above the swing high is a break I do not buy outside stage 2 (C2).

'Near a high is not a new high; C5 waits.' Agreed, and it is my C5 too: the buy is the breakout, not the anticipation. That is a timing point, not a refutation of the claim: ma50 279.18 > ma100 266.68 > ma200 241.46, rs_rank_pct 91.3 LEADER, W HH/HL 5.3% above its swing high. The template passes; my trigger is the daily close above pivot_high, D 2.0% overhead.

'Price fails C5 today: 4.5% under 20-day high.' C5 measures distance from the pivot, not from the 20-day high: D 1.2% above the last swing high is inside a few percent, W HH/HL 1.6% above its swing high. The template passes (ma50 100.72 > ma100 93.5 > ma200 91.35, rs_rank_pct 83.19). What is missing is breakout volume (day_vol 1.02, C6), so I wait for it; the claim stands.
